title.zh: 原子氢1s辐射复合速率系数

summary: Evaluate the saved H+ + e -> H(1s) + hv analytic rate coefficient from electron temperature in eV.

identity.relation: H+ + e -> H(1s) + hv radiative recombination rate coefficient as a function of electron temperature
identity.direction: electron temperature in eV -> rate coefficient in m^3/s
identity.definition: Clip strictly positive electron temperature to [0.1, 2.01e4] eV. With Ry=13.58 eV, n=1, A_nl=3.92 and x_nl=0.35, set ionization_energy=Ry/n and b_n=ionization_energy/T. Return A_nl*1e-14*sqrt(ionization_energy/Ry)*(b_n^1.5/(b_n+x_nl))*1e-6 m^3/s in the saved arithmetic order.
identity.model: saved level-1 Storey-type analytic fit with frozen constants; no external-data interpolation or runtime cross-section integral
identity.geometry: none; pointwise scalar or array material samples
identity.coordinates: electron temperature in eV, with no spatial axis inferred
identity.boundary: finite real numeric temperature strictly positive; endpoint clipping; finite positive represented output
assumptions: The saved Ry=13.58 eV, A_nl=3.92, x_nl=0.35 and n=1 constants and arithmetic order are retained for exact historical replay on finite positive real inputs.
Only ground-state H(1s) radiative recombination is represented; excited levels and other recombination mechanisms are separate relations.
The saved implementation clips nonpositive temperature and coerces boolean and numeric-string values. The maintained callable rejects them under the declared positive real input contract.

inputs.name: electron_temperature_ev
inputs.description: Electron temperature for the H(1s) radiative recombination fit.
inputs.constraints: Finite and strictly positive; positive values outside [0.1, 2.01e4] eV are clipped to the nearest endpoint.

outputs.name: rate_m3_s
outputs.constraints: Finite and strictly positive on accepted inputs; no external physical accuracy is asserted.

preconditions: The caller supplies electron temperature in eV and accepts saved endpoint clipping.
supported: Scalar and array evaluation of the saved H(1s) analytic fit on or clipped to its declared temperature interval.
excluded: Excited-level, three-body and dielectronic recombination, or electron-impact ionization.
A physically validated recombination model outside the saved comparison domain or without an external atomic-physics reference.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: Raises ValueError for non-real numeric, non-finite or nonpositive electron temperature. Boolean, complex and numeric-string coercions are rejected.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: Raises ValueError if the derived rate is non-finite or nonpositive; no partial output is returned.

example.description: Evaluate ground-state recombination and its clipped endpoints.
example.code:
import numpy as np
from scirel.collisions import evaluate_atomic_hydrogen_1s_radiative_recombination_rate
t = np.array([0.01, 1.0, 50000.0])
r = evaluate_atomic_hydrogen_1s_radiative_recombination_rate(t)
edge = evaluate_atomic_hydrogen_1s_radiative_recombination_rate(np.array([0.1, 1.0, 20100.0]))
assert r.shape == (3,) and np.all(np.isfinite(r)) and np.all(r > 0.0)
assert np.array_equal(r, edge)
example.expected: Three positive H(1s) rates with values outside the fit interval exactly repeating the endpoints.

scope: Six fixed saved reference values and an independent closed-form evaluation retain the intake candidate's 1e-15 relative tolerance, including a holdout grid.
Direct tests cover monotonic temperature dependence on the sampled grid, clipping, scalar shape, invalid domain and non-real input rejection.
Five optional SHA-gated historical replays compare finite one- and two-dimensional carriers exactly and document three rejection differences.
verification.evidence_ceiling: Maintained tests establish the saved closed form, clipping and failure contract on tested samples. SHA-gated replay establishes historical arithmetic agreement on compared grids only. No external atomic-physics oracle validates the fit; whole-source D1 qualification, expert approval and distribution licensing are absent.
known_limitations: The saved package records an external physical-reference validation_oracle_gap.
Ry=13.58 eV is the saved fit constant and is not replaced with a modern re-derived value.
Out-of-fit-range positive temperatures silently repeat endpoint rates.
The saved bundle's strict D1 qualification is withdrawn, and public distribution licensing remains pending.
